title: Finding
description: The unified Finding emitted by every reviewer agent in the CV Customizer Agent Suite (Requirement 9.1, design 'Data Models / Finding'). A Finding is a single structured observation about one of the Working Copies (or the package as a whole). 'current' and 'proposed' are optional because not every Finding carries text to change (e.g. a structural ATS hazard, or a hiring-manager concern, may describe a location and a rationale without a literal text replacement).

id.description: Stable identifier unique within the workflow run.

source_agent.description: Canonical name of the agent that produced the Finding (e.g. cv-spell-format-reviewer).

iteration.description: The orchestrator iteration number in which the Finding was produced.

target_document.description: Which document the Finding applies to; 'package_coherence' is a cross-document inconsistency.

category.description: The kind of issue. 'length' is used by the page-constraint reducer.

current.description: The current text/formatting state at the anchor, where applicable. Optional.

proposed.description: The proposed text/formatting change, where applicable. Optional.

rationale.description: Why the change is recommended, with citations where appropriate.

anchor.description: A stable reference into the target document identifying where the Finding applies. The schema is intentionally permissive so it accommodates BOTH the design's example anchor (an object with 'section' + 'paragraph_key' + 'match_text') AND the object anchors emitted by ats_structural.py (a 'type' + 'hazard' object carrying e.g. 'paragraph_key', 'section_index', 'table_index', or 'part'). At least one location-identifying key must be present so an empty object is rejected; any additional keys are allowed for forward compatibility (e.g. package_coherence anchors spanning both documents).

section.description: Nearest preceding heading text (human-readable section name).

section_index.description: Zero-based document section index (multi-column / header / footer hazards).

columns.description: Column count for a multi-column section hazard.

match_text.description: Substring within the anchored paragraph the Finding targets.

text.description: Snippet of the anchored paragraph's text (context).
